descriptions.description: Riverine and fen scrubs (F9 level 2)
Mixed deciduous and coniferous woodland (G4 level 2)
Macaronesia
Lectotype (Hampshire in Jarvis & al., Regnum Veg. 127: 43. 1993): [icon] " planta " in plukenet, Phytographia: t. 257, f. 5. 1694.
Generitype of Disandra Linnaeus.
Note: An illegitimate replacement name in Disandra for Sibthorpia peregrina L. (1753).
Lectotype (Hampshire in Jarvis & al., Regnum Veg. 127: 43. 1993): [icon] " Planta " in Plukenet, Phytographia: t. 257, f. 5. 1694.
" Habitat - - - - " RCN: 2637.

Note: Hedberg (in Bot. Not. 108: 175. 1955) indicated 475.1 (LINN) as lectotype, but it is annotated only with " Giseke " and associated in the herbarium with the illegitimate Disandra prostrata L. (1774). It is not original material for S. peregrina.
